provider.heading: AI provider
provider.description: Midnite uses an LLM to classify tasks, plan, and guide agents. Paste your API key here — it's encrypted at rest.

tools.heading: System tools
tools.description: Midnite runs <cli>claude</cli> to execute tasks and uses <gh>gh</gh> to open pull requests.

pool.heading: Concurrency
pool.description: How many tasks can run in parallel. Start low — you can always increase it in Settings.
pool.one: One task at a time (safe default).

repo.heading: Repository
repo.description: Add the repository Midnite will work in. You can add more later under Settings → Repos.

finish.almostDescription: A few items still need attention.

nudge.title: Finish setting up Midnite
nudge.stepsLeft: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} left before agents can run.
nudge.recommendedRemain: A couple of recommended steps remain.

cli.description: The {label} CLI is launched in a session terminal to run tasks. Install or update it here, then set it as the CLI used for new sessions.

api.description: Use your own {label} API key to power Midnite's AI features (task triage, plan drafting, the heartbeat and AI workflow nodes). Stored on the gateway; never shown again after saving.

cliAction.heading: {verb} {label}
cliAction.hintInstall: The install command is typed below
cliAction.hintUninstall: The uninstall command is typed below
cliAction.hintSuffix: {hint} — press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to run it. Close anytime.

guardrails.confirmStopDescription: Pauses all scheduling and aborts every in-flight agent. Aborted tasks return to Todo and re-run when you resume.
guardrails.bannerGlobal: Scheduling paused — no new agents will start.
guardrails.bannerScoped: Scheduling paused for {count, plural, one {# scope} other {# scopes}}.
